meta.title: Vault.exe
screens.instructions.title: How this desk works
screens.instructions.body:
Three phones, one desk. Each of you holds a different side of it — nobody sees everything.

Anything glowing amber is yours to touch. When something glows violet, the desk is doing it, not you.

What you find, say out loud. Numbers, letters, pictures — the person who needs them is sitting next to you.

Stuck? The hint board at the bottom knows your devices. Hints cost the team points; reading one again is free. If a puzzle really won't give, a skip appears after the last hint — it moves everyone on, for zero points.

Solve things, earn points, and whoever cracks a device gets the credit on every phone.
screens.story.title: Something was left for you
screens.story.body:
{owner_name} is gone — dramatically, mysteriously, or just to the beach, nobody's sure.

What's certain: {owner_name} left you the desk. And somewhere behind it, a vault — with, in {owner_name}'s own words, "the most valuable thing I own."

The desk remembers. Wake it up, and it will walk you to the vault.
screens.finale.title: Vault.exe is running…
el.die.name: Bone die
el.die.caption: Tap to roll. It lands 1, 1, 2, 5 — and then it lands 1, 1, 2, 5 again.
el.test.name: Math test
el.test.caption: A failed test and a black card, sitting where they fell.
el.radio.name: Shortwave receiver
el.radio.caption: Step the dial until the static thins. Say the number out loud.
el.audio.name: Broadcast
el.audio.caption: A voice over train sounds. Play it as many times as you need — and read it to the table.
el.train.name: Electric train
el.train.caption: Press the button as the train passes each character, in the order the voice on the radio reads them.
el.cal_small.name: Small calendar
el.cal_small.caption: It appeared in the middle of the track. It's pointing somewhere.
el.cal_big.name: Desk calendar
el.cal_big.caption: Four photographs. One of them wasn't there before.
el.calc.name: Calculator
el.calc.caption: It adds, and it holds what you type. Nothing else.
el.bulb.name: Small bulb
el.bulb.caption: It wasn't on the desk a minute ago.
el.lamp.name: Architect lamp
el.lamp.caption: Off, small light, big light. The slider stays locked until the desk gives it a reason.
el.notebook.name: Notebook
el.notebook.caption: Blank paper. Under the right light it stops being blank.
el.fish.name: Fishbowl
el.fish.caption: Cycle the formation, then press the colour the notebook gives it.
el.clock.name: Digital clock
el.clock.caption: Set the time and confirm. A wrong time costs the team a few points, then you can try again.
el.book.name: Book
el.book.caption: Shut fast. It opens when the clock is set right.
el.laptop.name: Laptop
el.laptop.caption: Six keys still work. Nobody knows the order — yet.
popups.radio: Radio tuned to 1125 FM! Nice catch, {player_name} — the dice and the test card were talking to each other.
popups.train: The train delivered! {player_name} caught every character in the broadcast's order.
popups.calc: 3954607 — accepted. {player_name} read a date no calendar should have.
popups.uv: UV on! {player_name} flipped the slider — every screen just changed. Look around.
popups.fish: The fish remember! {player_name} pressed the colours in the notebook's order — look what they're spelling.
popups.clock: 08:10 — confirmed. {player_name} set the desk's clock, and something just unlocked.
popups.laptop: Vault.exe is running. {player_name} found the order. Everyone — look up.
hints.radio.1: The die isn't broken, and the test wasn't graded by accident. Read both out loud, in that order.
hints.radio.2: Four rolls make a frequency: 1125. The grade and the card make the band: FM. Tune, then press ON.
hints.train.1: The voice reads five characters. The track shows the same five — scrambled. The order comes from the voice, not the track.
hints.train.2: Press exactly as the train passes: B, then G, then 7, then F, then 3. A miss only resets the current run.
hints.calc.1: One of the calendar photos shows a date that can't exist. Dates that can't exist make excellent codes.
hints.calc.2: Type the impossible date as one number — 3954607 — and press equals.
hints.uv.1: The little bulb didn't appear for decoration. The lamp's slider is waiting for it.
hints.uv.2: Press the lamp's slider. The fourth light isn't for reading.
hints.fish.1: The notebook's drawing is instructions: shapes in a row, each in its own colour.
hints.fish.2: Cycle to heart and press black, square and press blue, triangle and press yellow — in that order.
hints.clock.1: The fish aren't swimming anymore. They're writing. Read them left to right.
hints.laptop.1: The book didn't open to show you a photograph. Look at what's printed beside it.
hints.laptop.2: The book's clue gives the six symbols in order. Press them exactly; a wrong press resets all keys.
quips.framed_photo: {owner_name}, mid-laugh. Whoever took this knew them well.
quips.teddy: It smells faintly of {owner_name}'s cologne. Unsettling.
quips.glass: Half full. {owner_name} would insist on that phrasing.
quips.desktoy: It clicks forever if you start it. {owner_name} started it often.
custom.treasure_caption.default: A framed certificate: "World's Best Secret Keeper — awarded to myself."
custom.book_photo: A photo for the open book
custom.artifact_pick: Which of their belongings are on the desks?
